# KaTeX 0.19.1

Pinned browser distribution from https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.1.tgz.
Official API: https://katex.org/docs/api ; options: https://katex.org/docs/options.
MIT license retained in LICENSE. CSS and all referenced fonts are served locally.
Pseudo calls render with trust:false; no auto-render or remote resource loading.
Upgrade JS, CSS and fonts together, then run tests/test_pseudo.py.
